reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: The patch removes the timer that refocused the date field one millisecond after every redraw, which is what pulled focus back after Tab. A reviewer probe of the mouse paths the task does not cover (open by click, Next month, type, pick a day) gives the same focus and value with and without the patch.
caveats: The refocus is removed for every redraw, not only the one after change. The probe covered mouse navigation in desktop Chromium; touch devices were not tested.
Pikaday is archived, so this is a patch for teams that vendor it, not an upstream pull request.
